fileId.description: The file id from the `id` field returned by `repliz_init_file`.

search.description: Search in contact name and note.

tag.description: Only contacts with this exact tag (see repliz_list_contact_tags).

followUp.description: 'scheduled' for contacts with a follow-up, 'due' for follow-ups whose time has passed.

accountIds.description: Only contacts of these account id(s).

contentId.description: The content id to attach automation to.

accountId.description: The account id that owns the content.

config.description: Automation configuration object (delete, reply, like, message, story). Keywords in message, story and chat (Instagram and Facebook) can answer with buttons: a keyword.values item { "keyword", "type": "opening", "opening": { postback, additional, webUrl } } instead of { "keyword", "text" }. Send the "id" Repliz returns on such a keyword back unchanged, or the buttons in DMs already sent stop working. Schema: https://docs.repliz.com/api/guides/automation-config#keyword-with-buttons

contentId.description: The content id to comment on.

accountId.description: The account id posting the comment.

commentId.description: Reply to this comment id instead of the post.

url.description: Public URL of the image file.

image.description: Optional image sent along with the text. Supported on Facebook, Threads, TikTok, LinkedIn and X (Twitter), ignored on other platforms.

accountId.description: The target account id to publish to.

type.description: The kind of post to create.

description.description: The post caption/body text. Use '' if not needed.

scheduleAt.description: When to publish, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-06-20T09:00:00.000Z.

title.description: Post title (used by some platforms, e.g. YouTube and Pinterest).

url.description: Public URL of the media file.

thumbnail.description: Public URL of the thumbnail image.

customThumbnail.description: Whether a custom thumbnail is used.

items.description: A single media item attached to the post.

isAiGenerated.description: Label the post as made or changed with AI, with each platform own label. Used by TikTok video, YouTube video, Facebook reel, Pinterest and Threads (the post and every reply of the thread).

isShareToFeed.description: Whether to share to Instagram main feed. Only applicable for Instagram scheduled posts with type 'video'.

privacy.description: YouTube only: who can watch the video. 'unlisted' is watchable by link only, 'private' only by the channel owner. A private video is not listed by repliz_list_content, so its automation and statistics don't run.

graduationStrategy.description: 'MANUAL': the user shares the reel with their followers from the Instagram app. 'SS_PERFORMANCE': Instagram shares it with the followers automatically if it performs well. Empty for a regular reel.

trialParams.description: Instagram only, type 'video': post the reel as a trial reel, shown to non-followers first. Omit for a regular reel.

volume.description: Volume settings for video and music.

music.description: Background music attached to the post.

id.description: Channel, group or board ID as listed: WhatsApp ends in @newsletter or @g.us, Telegram is a number like -1001234567890, a Pinterest board is a number like 1006921296753698211.

picture.description: Channel, group or board picture URL.

type.description: Whether it is a channel, a group or a Pinterest board ('board'). Telegram ids look alike, so this decides where it posts.

channel.description: WhatsApp and Telegram: the channel or group to post to, an item from repliz_whatsapp_channels or repliz_telegram_channels; omit to post to the account's WhatsApp Status or Telegram story. Pinterest (required): the board to pin to, an item from repliz_pinterest_boards.

link.description: Pinterest only: the destination URL the pin opens when tapped.

text.description: The attached text, up to 10,000 characters, posted as plain text. Empty for no attachment.

link.description: Optional link shown at the end of the attachment.

textAttachment.description: Threads only, type 'text': a long text attached under the post that opens like an article. Each text reply can have its own in replies[].textAttachment. A post can have at most 5 links, counting the description and this link.

additionalInfo.description: Optional extras: collaborators, music, products, tags, mentions, isShareToFeed (Instagram video), privacy (YouTube: public, unlisted or private), trialParams (Instagram video: trial reel with graduationStrategy MANUAL or SS_PERFORMANCE), targetCountries, channel (WhatsApp, Telegram, Pinterest board), link (Pinterest), textAttachment (Threads text: a long text up to 10,000 characters, like an article, with an optional link).

textAttachment.description: Threads 'text' replies only: a long text attached under the reply that opens like an article, with the same rules as additionalInfo.textAttachment.

delay.description: Minutes to wait after the post before it (the main post for the first reply) is published. 0 or omitted posts it right away. Not less than the delay of the reply before it, and all delays together at most 1440 (24 hours).

replies.description: Follow-up posts in a thread/chain (Threads or X only), in order. Each can wait its own delay in minutes after the post before it.

templateId.description: Optional automation template id to apply to this post.

name.description: Name of the automation template (e.g. 'Auto Comment').

config.description: Automation template configuration object containing rules (delete, reply, like, message, chat, story). Keywords in message, story and chat (Instagram and Facebook) can answer with buttons: a keyword.values item { "keyword", "type": "opening", "opening": { postback, additional, webUrl } } instead of { "keyword", "text" }. Send the "id" Repliz returns on such a keyword back unchanged, or the buttons in DMs already sent stop working. Schema: https://docs.repliz.com/api/guides/automation-config#keyword-with-buttons

search.description: The keyword or phrase to search for.

sort.description: Sort order for search results ('TOP' or 'RECENT').

mode.description: Search mode ('KEYWORD' for keyword search, 'TAG' for hashtag search).

type.description: Filter results by post media type ('TEXT', 'IMAGE', or 'VIDEO').
